name: Emerson Electric
description: Emerson makes industrial automation hardware and software: control valves (Fisher), flow and process sensors (Rosemount, Micro Motion), control systems (DeltaV, Ovation), test-and-measurement systems from National Instruments (NI) and plant-optimisation software from AspenTech, which Emerson now owns in full after buying the remaining shares for about $7.2 billion in March 2025. Customers are process and hybrid industries (chemicals, energy, power, life sciences) and discrete manufacturers, who buy equipment and software once and then spares, services and subscriptions. It exited climate technologies (Copeland sold 2023 and its stake in 2024) and from fiscal 2026 reports five segments. Backlog is $8.6 billion.

employees.note: Approximately 71,000 employees; about 120 manufacturing locations (35 in the US).

businessLines.name: Intelligent Devices
businessLines.how: Sells control valves, actuators, regulators, process measurement instruments, pneumatic and solenoid valves and safety and productivity products to process, hybrid and discrete industries; one-time product sales with recurring spares, repair and service on the installed base.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-09-30), segment earnings; adjusted EBITA $3,212M

businessLines.name: Software and Control
businessLines.how: Sells distributed control systems and process software (DeltaV, Ovation, AspenTech licences and subscriptions) plus National Instruments test and measurement hardware and software; recurring software subscriptions and maintenance on top of long project-based system sales.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-09-30), segment earnings; adjusted EBITA $1,763M

brands.name: Fisher, Rosemount, Micro Motion, Bettis, DeltaV, Ovation, ASCO
brands.note: Product brands named in the 10-K descriptions; revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: AspenTech
brands.note: Industrial software; Emerson bought the remaining shares it did not own for about $7.2 billion on 2025-03-12 (now wholly owned)

brands.name: NI (National Instruments)
brands.note: Test & Measurement business acquired in fiscal 2024 (10-K: NI acquisition); FY2025 sales $1,486M, segment loss $(68)M

brands.name: Copeland (former Climate Technologies)
brands.note: Majority sold to Blackstone May 2023; the retained 40 percent stake was sold in August 2024; shown as discontinued operations.
